id: 01_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Introduction to Laboratory Safety
title: 走进实验室安全
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/01_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Introduction to Laboratory Safety.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/01_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Introduction to Laboratory Safety/src.py

points.K1: 实验室事故每年都在发生
points.K9: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
points.S1: 三级管理与第一责任人
points.S2: 先培训考核，再进实验室

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a bright university laboratory building and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们一起走进实验室安全。

shots.scene: 事故、文化、责任、改进四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a yellow warning triangle, a heart inside a flask, linked hands, and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 认识事故，建立文化，人人负责。

shots.scene: 阿杰披着头发、穿短裤，兴冲冲推开实验室门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with long loose hair, wearing shorts and sandals, cheerfully pushes open a laboratory door.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，兴冲冲就要开工。

shots.scene: 小研在门口拦住阿杰，指指他的短裤和拖鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student at the door and points at his shorts and sandals.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：这身打扮可不行。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，满脸不解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a puzzled face beside the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 阿杰不解：就做个小实验，有那么危险吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣从门边探出头，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot leans in from the doorway and raises one finger with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 我们先看看，实验室里会出什么事。

shots.section_title: 实验室事故每年都在发生
shots.scene: 地球图标上散布着几个小警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple globe icon with several small yellow warning triangles scattered over it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室事故，每年都在发生。
overlay: 实验室事故每年都在发生

shots.section_title: 实验室事故每年都在发生
shots.scene: 日历图标一页页翻过，每页都有一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon flipping pages, each page showing a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 它离我们并不远，不是偶然的个例。

shots.scene: 五个图标：溅洒的液体、针头、细菌、爆炸、火焰
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a splashing liquid drop, a syringe needle, a microbe, an explosion burst, and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒、针刺、感染、爆炸，都是常见事故。

shots.scene: 一个小人图标旁出现黑色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram next to a dark warning triangle with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 严重时，甚至会造成人员死亡。

shots.scene: 长发散开、露着手臂的小人做实验，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab worker with long loose hair and bare arms working at a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 事故最常发生在不守规范的时候。

shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白的规程手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank standard operating procedure binder on the bench.
shots.narration: 规程写下的，都是用教训换来的做法。

shots.scene: 一条不断向上延伸的楼梯，没有终点
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon that keeps rising upward without an end, with a small flag on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不是做完一次就结束的任务。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标中间是一个烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon surrounding a flask with a heart inside. No people.
shots.narration: 它要天天坚持，不断改进。

shots.scene: 实验室、校园人群和树木三个图标被一面盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protecting three smaller icons: a lab room, a group of people, and a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作，保护的是彼此、公众和环境。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套，用吸水纸覆盖台面上的小片溅洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and goggles covers a small spill on the bench with absorbent paper.
shots.narration: 一处溢洒及时处理，就不会影响别人。

shots.scene: 老周坐在台前操作，没戴护目镜；小研走近提醒
shots.prompt_en: The older man works at a bench without safety goggles; the female graduate student walks over and politely reminds him.
shots.narration: 发现问题，要马上指出、马上处理。

shots.scene: 老周笑着戴上护目镜，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The older man smiles, puts on safety goggles and gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 互相提醒，是共同的责任。

shots.scene: 一圈小人图标手拉手，围着中间的实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: A ring of person pictograms holding hands around a lab building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每个人的安全，取决于每个人的投入。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写字板，上面是空白的风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a clipboard with a blank risk assessment form and a magnifier icon.
shots.narration: 第一，以可靠的风险评估为基础。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套，在生物安全柜前操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, goggles and gloves works at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 第二，用安全的方法和合适的设备。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着一张空白流程图讨论，旁边有灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank flow chart, with a light bulb icon above them.
shots.narration: 第三，不断寻找更安全的做法。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本空白规程手册并排，规程手册更大
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 三级管理与第一责任人
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: A three-level step icon: a university building at the top, a school building in the middle, a lab room at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实行学校、学院、实验室三级管理。
overlay: 三级管理与第一责任人

shots.section_title: 三级管理与第一责任人
shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口，胸前戴空白工作牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the laboratory door wearing a blank name badge, arms crossed confidently.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是本实验室安全第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前答题，屏幕空白，旁边浮现对勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes an online test at a computer with a blank screen, a green check mark floating beside him.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先参加安全培训和考核。
overlay: 先培训考核，再进实验室

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 王老师把空白准入卡片交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank access card to the young male student.
shots.narration: 考核通过，取得准入，才能开始实验。

shots.scene: 阿杰换好长裤、包脚鞋，扎起头发，穿上实验服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student now wears long trousers, closed-toe shoes and a buttoned lab coat, with his hair tied back.
shots.narration: 长发束起，长衣长裤，不露脚面。

shots.scene: 短裤、拖鞋、散发三个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: shorts, open sandals, and long loose hair. No people.
shots.narration: 短裤、拖鞋不进实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 护目镜、手套，按实验风险选用。

shots.scene: 小研发现地上一根拖着的电线，用手机拍照
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices a power cord lying across the floor and photographs it with a blank phone.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，及时报告，不要视而不见。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，王老师在空白登记本上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man while the safety administrator writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，整改后再复查。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现警示三角、循环箭头和手拉手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a warning triangle, a circular arrow and linked hands.
shots.narration: 事故常有，多因不守规范。

shots.scene: 风险评估表、实验服、灯泡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank checklist with a magnifier, a lab coat, and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 评估在先，规范操作，持续改进。

shots.scene: 准入卡片和报告单图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank access card and a blank report form side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 先准入再开工，发现问题就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和穿戴整齐的阿杰一起挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the properly dressed young male student wave goodbye at the camera in front of the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 安全文化，从你我做起，下次见！
